# make_framework_scatter_trace { #mofography.movies.make_framework_scatter_trace }

```python
movies.make_framework_scatter_trace(
    atoms,
    bonds='auto',
    style=None,
    name='Framework',
    trace_id='framework',
    atom_scale=0.65,
    bond_color=None,
    bond_linewidth=8.0,
    depth_test=True,
)
```

Framework as scatter points + line segments (fast, no mesh geometry).

Returns {"atoms": trace, "bonds": trace} — suitable for MovieFigure.add_trace().
When *depth_test* is False the framework is always rendered on top.
